# MonoForge

> An open-source, AI-native GitHub profile README generator and visual studio.
> Production URL: https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app

MonoForge generates production-grade, GitHub-safe markdown profiles with zero required runtime servers. It supports visual drag-and-drop canvas editing, raw JSON /developer mode, dynamic vector animation, and 47+ official verified social platform integrations.

## Documentation & Studio

- [Visual Studio & Guided Wizard](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/wizard): Interactive visual README builder with real-time preview and drag-and-drop layout.
- [Visual Canvas Builder](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/canvas): Full canvas studio inspired by profile-readme-generator.com featuring My activities, Social Media, Texts, and Techs.
- [Developer Raw Mode IDE](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Raw-mode Monaco JSON editor with live markdown preview, 26+ plugins, and 50+ templates.
- [Dynamic Vector Animator](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/animator): Zero-script Camo-safe animated SVG hero banners, kinetic typography, and character kinematics.
- [Architecture & Guide Hub](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/info): Architectural guides, 50 curated visual archetypes, and documentation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/privacy-policy): Zero-telemetry client-side privacy disclosure.

## Developer & Machine Endpoints

- [JSON Schema API](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/schema): Machine-readable ReadmeConfig Zod/JSON schema.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive AI prompt instructions and schema models.
- [Agent Skill Spec](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/.agents/skills/monoforge/SKILL.md): Declarative AI agent skill for automated execution.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/monoforge): Open-source repository and issue tracker.
- [Sitemap XML](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Multi-language sitemap with hreflang alternate links.
- [Robots Policy](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/robots.txt): Search engine crawl policy and sitemap reference.

## 47 Supported Official Social Platforms

All badges support both raw vector SVG icon mode (`public/assets/icons/social/<platform>/default.svg`) and shields.io badge styles (`for-the-badge`, `flat`, `flat-square`, `plastic`):
- `behance`, `bluesky`, `codesandbox`, `codepen`, `devto`, `discord`, `dribbble`, `facebook`, `gitlab`, `gmail`
- `hackerrank`, `instagram`, `itch`, `linkedin`, `linktree`, `medium`, `microsoft-outlook`, `outlook`, `patreon`, `paypal`
- `spotify`, `stackoverflow`, `telegram`, `twitch`, `twitter`, `x`, `unsplash`, `visualstudio`, `wechat`, `whatsapp`
- `youtube`, `tutanota`, `matrix`, `ko-fi`, `signal`, `slack`, `tryhackme`, `leetcode`, `github`, `codeforces`
- `codechef`, `kaggle`, `hashnode`, `reddit`, `threads`, `tiktok`, `mastodon`

## Plugins & Features

- [Header & Bio](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Custom title, subtitle, status badge, pronouns, and avatar.
- [Capsule Banner](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Modern curved/waving capsule-render SVG hero banners.
- [Animated Mascot Bio](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Side-by-side or stacked animated mascot character with custom bio card.
- [Skill Icons Cluster](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Multi-icon SVG skill cluster with dark/light mode across Devicons, SkillIcons, Shields, and SimpleIcons.
- [Readme Typing SVG](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Dynamic typewriter headline via pure SVG animation.
- [Markdown Badges](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): 150+ technology, language, framework, and database badges.
- [GitHub Telemetry Stats](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Overall GitHub stars, commits, PRs, and review telemetry.
- [Streak Stats](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): GitHub contribution streak and total lifetime contributions.
- [Activity Graph](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Waveform contribution graph and activity trendlines.
- [Profile Trophies](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Gamified achievement trophies ranked by GitHub activity.
- [Languages Breakdown](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Top programming languages breakdown in donut, pie, or compact bar.
- [Pinterest Image Showcase](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Aesthetic image showcase resolved from direct Pinterest links or search queries.
- [Figma Design Showcase](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Design system tokens, prototype links, and Figma project cards.
- [Visitor Counter](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Non-invasive profile visitor counter badge.
- [Snake Game](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Animated retro snake eating through user contribution grid.
- [Social Links](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Social media, portfolio, and community contact badges with 47 verified platforms.
